name: x
description: A solid rounded square with a centered close cutout and two-unit clearance.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner-requested optical enlargement: X retains the 45-degree construction derived from Plus, with each diagonal centerline length increased from 14 to 16 units, extending both ends equally around 12,12. Stroke width stays Regular 1.70 and cap radius stays .85; the stroke and round ends are not scaled. The native visible dimensions become 13.0137085 by 13.0137085 units. Coordinates are baked into source at X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Plus remains unchanged. The Filled variant uses the exact Regular Outline exterior as its negative-space glyph in an upright solid rounded square with bounds 3.49314575..20.50685425 and radius-2.85 corners. Clearance remains exactly 2 native units on all four sides. This is the owner-requested Filled-only boxed treatment; Outline stays unboxed. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.
